GitHub CLI v2.102.0: quoted source excerpts and their interpretation.

Literal fields
https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_api
  -f, --raw-field <key=value>: "Add a string parameter in key=value format"
https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/v2.102.0/pkg/cmd/api/fields.go
  value = f[valueIndex:]
  if isMagic && value != nil {
      value, err = magicFieldValue(value.(string), opts)
  }
  for _, f := range opts.RawFields {
      if err := parseField(f, false); err != nil {
Raw fields retain their string value. Only magic fields invoke the conversion
that reads @files, substitutes placeholders, or converts JSON scalar types.

POST JSON body
https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/v2.102.0/pkg/cmd/api/http.go
  if strings.EqualFold(method, "GET") {
      requestURL = addQuery(requestURL, pp)
  } else {
      b, err := json.Marshal(pp)
      body = bytes.NewBuffer(b)
      bodyIsJSON = true
These are selected lines from the map-parameter branch: GET uses the query
string; other methods, including explicit --method POST, serialize JSON.

HTTP failures
https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/v2.102.0/pkg/cmd/api/api.go
  if serverError == "" && resp.StatusCode > 299 {
      serverError = fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
  }
  fmt.Fprintf(opts.IO.ErrOut, "gh: %s\n", serverError)
  err = cmdutil.SilentError
The latter two lines run when serverError is nonempty. JSON API error messages
include their HTTP status; a response without a parsed error uses HTTP <status>.
https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/v2.102.0/internal/ghcmd/cmd.go
  exitError   exitCode = 1
  if err == cmdutil.SilentError {
      return exitError
https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/v2.102.0/cmd/gh/main.go
  code := ghcmd.Main()
  os.Exit(int(code))
Thus HTTP failures such as 403 and 502 write diagnostics to stderr and exit 1.

Parent lookup diagnostic
https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/v2.102.0/pkg/cmd/api/api.go
  if parsedBody.Message != "" {
      return bodyCopy, fmt.Sprintf("%s (HTTP %d)", parsedBody.Message, statusCode), nil
  }
These lines from parseErrorResponse, together with the stderr formatter above,
render the captured message "No parent issue found" at status 404 as
"gh: No parent issue found (HTTP 404)". Generic "Not Found" at status 404 and
permission/validation failures remain distinct diagnostics. The captured API
body is in no-parent.json; no live gh capture is claimed.
